original_card.question: Can one specified masked or overcomplete decoder improve the complete moment budget?
methods: Synthesize a decoder with exact coefficients and fully priced helper endpoints.
Bound the best possible budget for a fixed support alphabet before synthesis.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Change an assumption of the eight-term all-pairs bound and count all copied information, frames and restoration.

first_step.inspect: Locate the excluded classes: masked identities, at least nine terms, and deeper punctures.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Choose one finite support alphabet and test exact decoding constraints before building a whole network.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A cheaper fully realized decoder could increase deficit or lower recursive cost on the binding complex side.
allowed_variations: Select a specific masked or overcomplete family with exact labels and supports.
scope_change_triggers: Repeating the exact eight-term all-pairs search inside its proved scope.

actual_scope: Which 8-subsets of P112 isolate a line in the live orthogonal-frame incidence, and what is the exact rational excess of the quadratic-extension kernel on each?
scope_change_reason: The card asks whether a masked decoder improves the moment. This package does not synthesize a decoder. It classifies the isolating 8-subsets in the P112 frame incidence, which is the masked even-entry constraint at the first deletion depth where global quadratic extension fails. That is the constraint side of the card's masked-identity exclusion, narrowed to those subsets. The eight-term all-pairs search is not repeated.
bottleneck_link: The complex side binds. Masked frame-sum constraints are the excluded class that could leave the trace-zero quadratic normal form and, if a fully charged decoder existed, lower the copy constant. The isolating census gives the exact kernel excess of every 8-deletion that frees a line. It is not itself a copy invoice or a kappa improvement.
stop_rule: Stop after the exhaustive isolating census and the rational kernel identification. Do not enumerate all C(112,8) subsets or nine-deletions in this session.
evidence: verify.py reports PASS_P112_ISOLATING_EIGHT_DELETIONS with 14 octet kernels of excess 7 and 672 double-isolation kernels of excess 2. The odd-prime sandwich uses p=1000003. One seven-subset, one damaged octet, and one generic 8-set are controls. Discussion writes were forbidden by the integration token and were not retried.
author: Riquelme Pereira
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance with the census, the rank argument, the verifier, and the notes. No coding-agent product is named.

open_questions.question: Does any 8-subset of P112 that isolates no line have positive quadratic-extension excess?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A positive answer would add extension failures beyond the 686 isolating sets and could make the maximum eight-deletion excess larger than 7.
open_questions.first_step: Run the same odd-prime sandwich on one lex-minimal set of orbit representatives for the 8-subsets under the stabilizer of FRAME0.
open_questions.blocked_by: There are 475491062970 subsets. This session did not build a stabilizer-chain census.

open_questions.question: What is the maximum quadratic-extension excess at nine deletions?
open_questions.why_it_matters: PR 5957 names nine as the injectivity limit of the quadratic span, so the excess can change there.
open_questions.first_step: Enumerate size-9 transversals of the same 1260 frames and apply the odd-prime sandwich.
open_questions.blocked_by: The size-8 shapes do not list the size-9 transversals, and the non-isolating gap is still open at size 8.

open_questions.question: Does a double-isolation kernel of excess 2 yield a masked decoder whose fully charged copy cost is below 64?
open_questions.why_it_matters: That is the moment question on this card. Kernel excess alone does not change kappa.
open_questions.first_step: Convert one double-isolation 8-set and its two isolated lines into supports and price frames, restoration, and copied labels.
open_questions.blocked_by: No copy invoice is implied by the incidence kernel.
